proposer_notes: The pattern that recurred across trains 22-34: a fix that is correct in isolation lands in the wrong copy of the truth (GATE-A-TOKENS' kit-only patch, echoing an earlier train's identical miss one wave prior), a hand-built namespace or resolver drifts from the module or corpus it wraps (IN-CHUNK-2's missing db.guardedUpdateByIds entry, LEGACY-3/LEGACY-4's resolver measured against only one of three live id shapes), and every one of these was found by a live run failing or a lane's own honest re-reading, never by the test suite (IN-CHUNK-2's 73 tests injected a fake db and never exercised the real namespace; FIRSTPAGE and FWD-TEXT's defects were found by the coordinator reading the live page, not a snapshot test). Proposal for the next cycle: require a lane whose diff touches a hand-maintained copy, a hardcoded namespace object, or a resolver's input-shape assumption to grep the actual call sites or live data for every OTHER shape that assumption excludes before landing — the same discipline BACKLOG-LEGACY's '11/11' measurement, IN-CHUNK-2's db namespace, and the Gate-A kit copy all lacked, made mechanical rather than left to a lane's own honesty. Run-007's own proposal (a JOIN CHECK line in every lane brief) targets exactly this class; whether it was added to briefs this cycle could not be confirmed from the postscripts (see metrics.run_007_proposal_status) — its companion proposal (coordinator re-hash of every PENDING-RUN.md after the last merge) was implemented and is what this very run discharges.
